set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Day-based puzzle
set.stimulus:
Seven persons — M, N, O, P, Q, R and S — go to a painting class on different days of the same week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday. Only one person goes on each day. Each of them likes a different flower — Daisy, Orchid, Sunflower, Tulip, Marigold, Lotus and Rose.

1. As many persons go before the one who likes Daisy as after S.
2. As many persons go before the one who likes Daisy as after the one who likes Marigold.
3. Only one person goes between R and the one who likes Sunflower, and R goes after the one who likes Sunflower.
4. M goes after O.
5. The one who likes Rose does not go immediately after or immediately before P.
6. Only one person goes between the one who likes Tulip and the one who likes Orchid, and the one who likes Tulip goes after the one who likes Orchid.
7. Only two persons go before N.
8. More than three persons go between R and the one who likes Marigold.
9. More than two persons go before the one who likes Orchid.
10. Less than four persons go between the one who likes Marigold and M.
11. P likes Orchid.
